errors.text_span: вероятно импулс на инфлацията и импулс на заплатите
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly interprets the chart as showing two separate impulses. The chart, an impulse response function, shows the response of one variable (inflation) to a shock in another (wages), with the red lines being confidence intervals, not a second impulse.
The description states there are two lines, but the figure clearly displays three lines: one solid blue line and two dotted red lines.

errors.text_span: Втората линия е червена, пунктирана, и започва при стойност около 1.0 при X = 1, показва леко растящ тренд до около 1.4 при X = 3, след което постепенно намалява и достига стойност около –0.5 при X = 8.
errors.evidence: This description incorrectly combines the two separate red dotted lines into a single, non-existent line. It takes the starting point of the upper red line and describes a path that ends near the final point of the lower red line. No single line in the chart follows this trajectory.

errors.text_span: червената линия преминава от положителни към отрицателни стойности, като има визуален връх около X = 3
errors.evidence: This statement describes the trajectory of the hallucinated single red line. In reality, there are two red lines: one is always positive, and the other starts near zero and becomes negative. Neither line has a peak at X=3 and then crosses the x-axis.
